preconditions.description: The number of vertices n and queries q are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= ai <= n for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each vertex value ai is a non-negative integer not exceeding n.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= u < v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: The tree has exactly n-1 edges, and each edge connects two distinct vertices.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in queries) and all(u == ancestor_of(v, tree) for u, v in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query (u, v) has u as an ancestor of v in the tree, including u = v.
The given edges form a valid tree with root at vertex 1.

postconditions.expression: len(output_lines) == q and all(output_lines[i].isdigit() for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: The output contains exactly q lines, each representing a valid integer answer.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(output_lines[i]) <= n for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: Each answer is a valid vertex value (ai) in the range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_lines[i]) == max(a[vertex] ^ dist(vertex, v) for vertex in path(u, v, tree)) for i, (u, v) in enumerate(queries))
postconditions.description: For each query (u, v), the answer is the maximum value of (ai XOR dist(i, v)) for all vertices i on the path from u to v (inclusive). Here, dist(i, v) is the number of edges on the path from i to v, and XOR is the bitwise exclusive OR operation.

invariants.expression: tree is a rooted tree with root at vertex 1 and edges defined by the input.
invariants.description: The tree structure remains consistent throughout the computation.

invariants.expression: a is a list of vertex values indexed from 1 to n.
invariants.description: The vertex values a are immutable and indexed by vertex number.
